_comment: P9 DFM fix, work order 2 (dfm_clearance 0.0127 mm on F.Cu at 39.6685,51.0514). DIAGNOSIS: both features are GND. Feature A is the priority-3 F.Cu GND zone 23751538 (region 38.4,46.15-48.6,51.1) whose fill tops out at y=51.1. Feature B is a 0.0029 mm2 SEVEN-VERTEX CRUMB of the priority-0 board-wide GND pour e1127fa3, trapped in the 0.02 mm lane between that zone's top edge (51.1) and the P8 Z2 zone's bottom edge (51.12), and fused to Z2's fill. A second, longer hair of the same origin sits at x 40.1891-42.1212 (0.02 x 1.93 mm, 0.0384 mm2). Both are PRIORITY-SUBTRACTION RESIDUE: KiCad deburrs a pour at min_thickness (0.25) BEFORE subtracting higher-priority zone outlines, so a sub-min_thickness lane left between two zone outlines is refilled by the lower-priority pour and never deburred away. The 12.7 um gap is between zone 23751538's min_thickness-rounded top-left corner and that crumb. FIX: one GND F.Cu zone at priority 6 straddling the seam (y 50.90-51.30 spans both 51.1 and 51.12), so no lane exists for the board pour to residue into. Same-net zones of DIFFERENT priority are subtracted by OUTLINE with ZERO clearance (measured on this board: zone 23751538's fill has literal vertices at x=42.4, exactly Z1's outline edge), so the bridge fill ABUTS zone 23751538 below and Z2 above and the three merge into one copper island - the merge the work order asked for. Geometry chosen to avoid regressions: y1 50.90 clears R4 pad 2 (GND, top 50.778) so no pad changes zone ownership, y2 51.30 clears R4 pad 1 (/RT, bottom 51.472); the band holds ZERO vias (nearest are 38.9,50.345 and 40.972,53.093) so neither this zone nor Z2 gains a second pour attachment and check_current's pour-neck test still skips them; 0.4 mm height is above min_thickness 0.25 so the fill survives deburring; x range 38.25-42.35 matches Z2 exactly so no new zone-outline lane is created on either side; priority 6 differs from every zone it overlaps (23751538=3, Z2=4, board pour=0) so KiCad 10's zones_intersect (same-net SAME-priority only) cannot fire, and no other priority-6 zone overlaps it (the /SW pour at priority 6 is at 46.3,43.2-49.8,47.3). connect solid matches zone 23751538, whose territory the bridge takes over.
